title: Mirror For Your Soul

cover.scene: A small child sitting on a hill looking up at a huge glowing full moon, tiny stars around.
cover.text: Some images don't just catch your attention. They hold a mirror to your soul.

caption: Some images don't just catch your attention... they hold a mirror in front of your soul 🪞✨ Which one hit you the hardest? 👇

slides.scene: A tiny green seedling pushing up through a crack in a heavy grey concrete slab, little bits of broken concrete around it.
slides.quote: Pressure is not the end of growth. It's where it begins.

slides.scene: A little turtle walking steadily along a dirt path while a rabbit sleeps under a tree far behind.
A big elephant tied to a tiny wooden stake in the ground with a thin rope, looking down at it.
slides.quote: Some chains exist only in your mind.

slides.scene: A small bird sitting calmly on a thin cracked branch that is bending, wings slightly open.
slides.quote: A bird trusts its wings, not the branch.

slides.scene: A tiny ant carrying a big green leaf many times its size up a small hill.
slides.quote: You are stronger than the weight you carry.

slides.scene: A green caterpillar looking into a puddle and seeing a colourful butterfly reflected in the water.
slides.quote: Who you are becoming matters more than who you were.

slides.scene: A small paper boat sailing on stormy blue waves towards a red and white lighthouse.
slides.quote: Calm seas never made a skilled sailor.

slides.scene: One lit candle leaning over to light a second candle, both glowing warmly.
slides.quote: You lose nothing by helping someone else shine.
